wiki.title: Ken Croken
wiki.extract: Kenneth R. Croken (born 1950) is an American politician and retired attorney who has represented the 97th district of the Iowa House of Representatives since January 2023, which consists of part of eastern Davenport in Scott County. He is a member of the Democratic Party.
